name: dev-go-mod-download-from-private-proxy
why: A module zip from the private proxy, as go mod download reads it.

job.purpose: go mod download for this repo, reading modules from goproxy.acme.dev

statements: allow read on module in module proxy "goproxy.acme.dev"

definitions.module proxy: A Go module proxy, by its host.
